changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Keep the source journal concept and description on every native GL posting.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE acc_gl_journal_entry entry SET header_concept = journal.source_header_concept, header_description = journal.source_header_description FROM credesal_arissto_gl_journal_line line JOIN credesal_arissto_gl_journal journal ON journal.id = line.journal_provenance_id WHERE entry.id = line.target_journal_entry_id;
